chunks: Hearken to your Lord before the Day arrives from God that will not be averted. You will have no place of refuge then nor time for denying.
ai.seo_question: What happens on the Day of Resurrection when it cannot be averted?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ash-Shura is often linked to the concept of *Istijab* (answering the call), urging immediate obedience to the Prophet and the Imams before the finality of death. It emphasizes the inevitability of the Day of Judgment (*Yawm al-Qiyamah*), where the 'no refugue' (*la malja'a*) signifies that worldly power and intercession will be useless without prior sincere submission to divine authority.
